Split signatures.py: builtin sigs, comparison and recipes out of it (#70)

- Hand-made signatures for builtins inspect can't read, and
  _robust_signature_of_callable, move to the dependency-free dol/sig_builtins.py
  (signatures imports it at the top).
- Signature comparison and call compatibility (compare_signatures,
  param_comparator, is_call_compatible_with, SigPair, ...) move to
  dol/sig_compare.py.
- The recipes built on Sig (call_forgivingly, ch_func_to_all_pk,
  all_pk_signature, replace_kwargs_using, sig_to_dataclass, ...) move to
  dol/sig_recipes.py.
- dol.signatures keeps Sig and re-exports every moved name; the back-compat
  snapshot test covers it.

No behaviour change.
